visual.description: Bold orange used as the primary hero and CTA section background, defining Hydra's brand color.
True black used as the main page background between sections.
Very dark charcoal used for elevated card/panel surfaces and the footer area.
White used for headings and body text on dark backgrounds.
Black used for headings and nav text rendered on the orange hero background.
Orange used as an accent color for highlighted text spans, icons, check icons, and inline emphasis.
White pill button background for the primary 'Book a demo' CTA.
Black circular icon background appended to the primary CTA button.
Dark grey used for borders on ghost/outline buttons in the community section.
Off-white / near-white used as the background for feature/capability tiles in the hosted Hydra grid.
Transparent over orange hero — nav inherits the orange hero background at top of page.
Black nav links and logo text rendered over the orange hero background.
Black background the nav takes once the user scrolls past the hero.
White nav links and logo text in the scrolled/opaque nav state.
Medium grey used for secondary body text and caption-level information.
